compositionHypothesis.stated: ASSF lifecycle remains the certification/UAT authority; a behavioral-evaluation contract supplies evidence to it; release gate and provider canary are domain-specific consumers or adapters, not the generic owner
compositionHypothesis.canonicalOwner: new generic ASSF-composed Behavioral Evaluation Contract (working name CVF_ASSF_BEHAVIORAL_EVALUATION_CONTRACT)

behavioralContract.positiveNegativeInvocation: every fixture set requires at least one positive case (correct instructed behavior) and at least one negative case (tool-order violation, missing required output, or forbidden action attempt); positive-only fixture sets cannot reach PASSED evidence status
behavioralContract.outcomeAndProcessAssertions: two independent required assertion classes: outcome assertions check final output shape/value; process/tool assertions check the sequence and identity of tool/file/command invocations against an allowed-order list; correct outcome via a forbidden process is a defect, not a pass
behavioralContract.toolOrderConstraints: each skill declares an explicit allowed-transition table; an undeclared transition is a fail-closed defect regardless of outcome

repeatPolicy.stochasticSkills: 3 consecutive passing repeats required before uatState: PASSED is recorded

behavioralContract.withWithoutBaselineControls: WITH and WITHOUT runs must share byte-identical input fixtures and must differ specifically on the checked outcome/process assertions; a WITH run with unproven marginal value over WITHOUT is rejected, not accepted
behavioralContract.mockReplayProvenance: any mocked/replayed trace must carry an explicit provenance field (source commit/date) and an expiry field; an expired or provenance-less mock trace is rejected; a mock/replay result may never be cited as LIVE or provider/live proof
behavioralContract.regressionPromotionInvalidation: evidence is invalidated whenever the skill's canonicalRoot source content hash changes; passing evidence never carries forward across a source change without a fresh repeat
behavioralContract.workerGraderSeparation: fixture-runner (produces a trace) and grader (scores the trace) are two independently invokable functions with no shared mutable state; the grader never trusts a runner self-declared pass field; defect classes are pre-declared before any real trace exists
behavioralContract.evidenceProjection: grader output populates the existing acceptanceEvidence and uatState package fields by citing a governed review artifact path; the grader never writes certificationState: CERTIFIED, which remains a reviewer/closer decision
behavioralContract.unknownHandling: fail-closed on every unknown/malformed input: INCOMPLETE_TRACE, UNDECLARED_TOOL_USE, STALE_REPLAY_PROVENANCE, NONEQUIVALENT_BASELINE_PAIR, INSUFFICIENT_REPEAT_EVIDENCE are all named defect classes, never silently passed

negativeCases.requirement: runner and grader are separately invokable; a runner-declared PASS field is never trusted by the grader
a trace missing a required tool-call or output field is INCOMPLETE_TRACE, never silently scored as a pass
an undeclared tool/action invocation is UNDECLARED_TOOL_USE regardless of outcome
a mock/replay trace whose declared source commit no longer matches the current canonicalRoot hash is STALE_REPLAY_PROVENANCE
a WITH/WITHOUT pair built from different inputs is NONEQUIVALENT_BASELINE_PAIR
fewer than 3 consecutive passing repeats on a stochastic skill is INSUFFICIENT_REPEAT_EVIDENCE

evidenceFlow: fixture: one input scenario plus expected outcome/process assertions plus declared allowed-transition table
invocation: skill behavior exercised live, live-with-repeat, or provenance-tagged mock/replay
trace: recorded tool/output event sequence, independent of any self-declared pass/fail
grader: pure function of (fixture, trace) -> {result, defects[]}; pre-declared defect classes; never mutates trace
result: PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE | FAIL_WITH_DEFECTS | INSUFFICIENT_REPEAT_EVIDENCE | STALE_REPLAY_PROVENANCE | INCOMPLETE_TRACE | UNDECLARED_TOOL_USE | NONEQUIVALENT_BASELINE_PAIR
projection: a governed review artifact cites the result and updates only the package uatState field; certificationState is never auto-set
